result.title: Unbalanced Optimal Transport for Efficient Visual Document Retrieval
result.summary: Vision-Language Models(VLMs)have advanced Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) by enabling OCR-free, multi-vector representations. However, these models generate excessive tokens to preserve dense visual details, which severely limits retrieval scalability. Existing compression methods mitigate this overhead but rely on isolated heuristics that fail to balance token importance, semantic redundancy, and coverage capacity. We propose a visual token compression framework formulated as an Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) problem. Our approach unifies these three objectives into a single alternating optimization process. Furthermore, we theoretically show that minimizing the transport cost upper-bounds the MaxSim retrieval error, ensuring ranking stability. Extensive experiments on the ViDoRe V1 and V3 benchmarks demonstrate that our method preserves fine-grained document semantics and improves the efficiency-effectiveness trade-off over state-of-the-art base-lines. Code is available at https://github.com/shhhhhyy/Unbalanced-Optimal-Transport-for-EVDR.

AI.brief_summary: 将视觉 token 压缩建模为非平衡最优传输问题，用交替优化统一 token 重要性、语义冗余与覆盖度三个目标，并证明降低传输代价可上界 MaxSim 检索误差，在 ViDoRe V1/V3 上验证效率与效果的权衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「重要性—冗余—覆盖」的视觉 token 筛选准则与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、细节保留问题可能相通，且传输代价上界检索误差的论证可供核查是否适用于 latent 状态选择；但论文目标是文档检索而非多模态推理，迁移需人工判断。
